newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli wages resume growth in third quarter.
newsitem.headline: Israeli wages resume growth in third quarter.

text.p: The average gross wage in Israel, not counting Palestinians from the West Bank and Gaza, rose a real 0.5 percent in the third quarter from a year earlier, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.
The rise follows a nil year-on-year increase in the second quarter and a 1.9 percent rise in the first, bringing the nine-month year-on-year increase to 0.8 percent.
The 1996 rise marks a slowing from the 1995 period, when the average wage rose 2.6 percent. The average gross monthly wage in September was 5,040 shekels, the bureau added.
Wages rose the fastest in the public sector, where the average gross salary was up 3.8 percent in the nine months.
The number of job posts rose 4.8 percent in the nine months, slowing from a 6.8 percent rise in the 1995 period.
